# coralogix_user (Data Source)

Coralogix User. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/manage-team-members/.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coralogix_user" "imported_by_id" {
  id = coralogix_user.example.id
}

data "coralogix_user" "imported_by_user_name" {
  user_name = "example@coralogix.com"
}

resource "coralogix_group" "members_by_email" {
  display_name = "example-members-by-email"
  role         = coralogix_custom_role.example.name
  members      = [data.coralogix_user.imported_by_user_name.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) User ID. Exactly one of `id` or `user_name` must be set.
- `user_name` (String) User name (email). Exactly one of `id` or `user_name` must be set. The lookup is case-insensitive, since SSO login can normalize letter case in the backend.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean)
- `emails` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--emails))
- `groups` (Set of String)
- `name` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name))
